entries.en: to praise; to extol
entries.notes: 官话栏作「Gegen. sien」，前段疑为误录或旁注，全条仅西语词头 alabar 可据；汉栏「阐/闸」字形两可，未能互证。

entries.en: to praise; to commend

entries.zh: 称扬；述其德行而颂美之
entries.en: to extol; to praise by recounting someone's virtues

entries.zh: 称呼；以尊称相称，兼含推崇
entries.en: to address (with a title); to speak of with esteem
entries.notes: 汉栏「称呼」本指称名称呼，与西语「赞美并重视」略有出入，取「以尊称相称」为解。

entries.en: to extol; to praise with admiration
to admire; to be well pleased with
entries.notes: 单字「欣」本义喜乐，此处取「称赏、喜爱」之引申义。

entries.en: to admire; to praise admiringly
to extol; to raise up in praise
entries.notes: 单字「举」本义举起，此处取「称举、抬举」之引申义。

entries.en: to praise the learned; to advance the worthy
entries.notes: 缩写「D r s」推为 doctores（博学之士），与汉栏「举贤人」相合。

entries.en: to extol; to recommend as worthy
entries.notes: 西语「es grandecer」即 engrandecer（张大、显扬），汉栏作「荐」，取荐举推重之义。

entries.en: to praise oneself; to boast
entries.notes: 西语「asi'nejmos」即 a sí mismos，汉栏字形疑为「衒」（自衒＝自夸）之形近讹。

entries.en: to show off; to boast
to swagger; to put on a bold front
entries.notes: 西语「onstble」未能辨读，汉栏「逞头皮」亦晦，仅就「逞」字与前后自夸诸条定其大意。

entries.en: to boast of one's strength
to boast of one's bravery
to give vent to one's temper; to show off one's spirit
entries.notes: 西语栏「se Podolipuede」残损难通，义据汉栏「逞气」及两音栏定。

entries.zh: 逞豪杰；自夸豪强、称雄逞意
entries.en: to boast of being mighty; to get one's way
to boast and grow haughty; to be arrogant

entries.zh: 讨着就无；口称富有，求之则一无所有
entries.en: to boast of wealth and give nothing when asked

entries.zh: 通称羡；为人所普遍称羡
entries.en: to be universally admired and praised
entries.notes: 西语栏「seyendo d'acierta」残损，义从汉栏「通称羡」。

entries.en: to praise; to commend
entries.notes: 官话栏作「pon.」，与「褒」对音不合，然西语、汉栏、闽南栏三者一致，于义无可疑。
